title: 第十七章 西隆老大第十八章 乱石地
lines: 棘砾趴在溪涧边，用力按住那只还在抽搐的狍鹿，心里振奋欣喜。
狍鹿在赭石谷越来越少，又极其警惕，速度很快，稍一惊动就跑没影了，要是没点特长，真是很难狩猎。
棘砾今天什么事都不干，就跟这些狍鹿较劲，在无数次失败之后，才终于沿着溪涧穷追不舍，逮到这么一只。
她按着那只狍鹿，小口小口喘气，警惕的观察四周。
次龙不像真龙，没有生而知之的本领，也没有重质龙那样强悍的身躯，虽然正在觉醒魔力，但还是很孱弱。
因此在山谷里行走，必须要小心翼翼，否则，很容易就要惹麻烦。
这时，一阵杂乱的声音从山坡上滚下来。
棘砾的动作僵住了，她甚至不用抬头，光听那种尖声嘶叫、张狂得意的动静，就知道来的是谁。
镍龙。
三四条镍龙，连蹦带跳来到溪边，把棘砾团团围住。
它们个头不大，鳞片是一种暗淡无光的白灰色，挤在一起，活像一窝刚从泥地里钻出来的老鼠。
领头那条来得最快，脑袋上有一片歪歪扭扭的黑斑。
棘砾认得这个家伙，比多·西诺兹，恶棍中的恶棍。
“让我看看，一条棘龙，叫做棘砾，是不是？次龙的名字，我都记得。”
比多有点得意，歪着脑袋，眼睛在棘龙脸上扫一圈，又看向她面前的狍鹿，“不愧是次龙，擅长狩猎，猎狗一样。”
棘砾下意识把那只狍鹿往身下扒，爪子按得更紧。
她不回话，这些镍龙，越说话越来劲，就喜欢胡搅蛮缠，但凡和它们多说一个字，都是给自己找麻烦。
“藏什么藏？”
比多凑上来，小眼睛里露出理所当然的贪婪，“喂哺者天天给你们发放血食，份量比我们都多，难道还不够你吃么？吃了血食，还要跳出来抢我们的狍鹿，真可耻，山谷里的东西，都要被你们这些次龙吃光了。”
他说着，舔了舔牙齿，“交出来吧，我们在上面看了半天，心里都等急了。”
棘砾喉咙里发出低低的吼叫，把狍鹿守在身下。
可即便如此，她也清楚，被这些镍龙围住之后，再想护食，已经是很难了。
她心里恨透了镍龙，镍龙是重质龙里最弱小的，它们不敢出现在王种铁龙面前，也不敢招惹上位种铬龙和钴龙，就只会把眼睛挂在次龙身上。
次龙走到哪里，这些镍龙就欺压到哪里，食腐的秃鹫似的，无论怎么甩、怎么躲，都逃不掉。
棘砾心里愤怒，有心想去呼唤同伴，次龙里也有些天赋异禀的，余焰、因塔斯、雷森……
如果它们在的话，未必不能和这些镍龙斗一斗。
眼看次龙毫无眼色，比多也懒得废话，他一摆头，两条镍龙立刻欺压上来，露出锋利的獠牙，准备动手强抢。
溪涧下游传来一声闷响。
一条钨龙走近过来，用尾巴拍打地面，鳞片是铁木叶的青绿色，“你们这些镍龙，是不是又要盯着次龙欺负？”
山谷不大，雏龙很多，彼此碰到都是常事。
镍龙比多獠牙一咧，转头看向钨龙。
他心里有些恼火，却没急着答话。
钨龙在重质龙里排名第四，主要擅长装模作样，表现出温和善良的天性，用来讨好喂哺者、亲近王种和上位种。
因为这样的原因，这些钨龙在山谷里，很是有些优待。
有时候就连铁龙也会带着它们一块玩，所以比较棘手。
比多不想和钨龙爆发冲突。
“我们都是朋友，正凑在一起玩呢，跟你没关系，钨龙。”
比多换了一副表情，笑嘻嘻的，又瞥一眼次龙，“棘砾，我们很早就认识了，是不是？”
“谁跟你认识？”棘砾低吼。
“让它走。”
钨龙压近过来，把那颗生满犄角的脑袋一沉，“你们就是要抢它的野食，想吃狍鹿，自己去抓！”
content_en:
Ji Li lay down by the stream, holding down the still twitching roe deer, feeling excited and happy.
There are fewer and fewer roe deer in the Ocher Valley. They are extremely vigilant and very fast. They will disappear at the slightest alarm. It is really difficult to hunt without some special skills.
Ji Li did nothing today, just competed with these roe deer. After countless failures, he finally chased along the stream and caught such one.
She held the roe deer, panted, and watched her surroundings vigilantly.
Unlike the real dragon, the secondary dragon does not have the ability to know things from birth, nor does it have a strong body like the heavy dragon. Although it is awakening its magic power, it is still very weak.
Therefore, you must be careful when walking in the valley, otherwise, you will easily get into trouble.
At this time, a chaotic sound rolled down the hillside.
Ji Li's movements froze, and she didn't even need to raise her head. She knew who was coming just by hearing the screams and arrogant and proud movements.
Nickel Dragon.
Three or four nickel dragons jumped up to the stream and surrounded the thorny gravel.
They are small in size, and their scales are a dull white-grey. They are crowded together, like a nest of rats that just emerged from the mud.
The leader came the fastest and had a crooked black spot on his head.
Thornstone recognized this guy, Bido Sinoz, a villain's villain.
"Let me see, there is a Spinosaurus called Spinosaurus, right? I remember the name of the Spinosaurus."
Bido was a little proud. She tilted her head and scanned the Spinosaurus's face with her eyes, then looked at the roe deer in front of her. "As expected of the Spinosaurus, it's good at hunting, just like a hunting dog."
Ji Li subconsciously pushed the roe deer under him and pressed his claws tighter.
She didn't reply. These nickel dragons became more and more energetic as they talked, and they liked to mess around. If you said one more word to them, you would cause trouble for yourself.
"What are you hiding?"
Bido came closer, with a natural greed in his little eyes, "The feeders give you blood food every day. The portion is more than us. Isn't it enough for you? After eating blood food, you have to jump out to snatch our roe deer. It's really shameful. Everything in the valley will be eaten by you dragons."
He said, licking his teeth, "Hand it over, we've been watching it for a long time, and we're all impatient."
Ji Li let out a low roar from his throat and held the roe deer under him.
But even so, she knew that it would be difficult to protect food after being surrounded by these nickel dragons.
She hated the nickel dragon in her heart. The nickel dragon was the weakest among the heavy dragons. They did not dare to appear in front of the king iron dragon, nor did they dare to provoke the high-ranking chromium dragon and cobalt dragon. They would only focus on the secondary dragons.
Wherever the secondary dragon goes, these nickel dragons will bully them, like scavenging vultures. No matter how hard they shake or dodge, they can't escape.
Ji Li was angry and wanted to call his companions. There were also some talented people among the Cilongs, Yu Yan, Intas, Leisen...
If they were there, they might not be able to fight with these nickel dragons.
Seeing that Cilong was expressionless, Bidu was too lazy to talk nonsense. He shook his head, and the two nickel dragons immediately bullied him, revealing their sharp fangs, ready to rob him.
There was a muffled sound from the lower reaches of the stream.
"Hello."
A tungsten dragon approached and slapped the ground with its tail. Its scales were the green color of iron wood leaves. "Are you nickel dragons going to stare at the sub dragon again?"
The valley is not big and there are many young dragons, so it is common for them to encounter each other.
Nickel Dragon bared his fangs and turned to look at Tungsten Dragon.
He was a little annoyed, but he didn't rush to answer.
Tungsten dragon ranks fourth among the heavy dragons. It is mainly good at showing off and showing a gentle and kind nature. It is used to please the feeders and get close to the king species and superior species.
For this reason, these tungsten dragons are given some preferential treatment in the valley.
Sometimes even Iron Dragon will play with them, so it's a bit tricky.
Bido didn't want to have a conflict with Tungsten Dragon.
"We are all friends, just hanging out together. It has nothing to do with you, Tungsten Dragon."
Bi Duo changed his expression, smiled, and glanced at Cilong again, "Ji Li, we have known each other for a long time, right?"
"Who knows you?" Ji Li growled.
"Let it go."
The tungsten dragon came closer and lowered its head full of antlers, "You just want to steal its wild food. If you want to eat the roe deer, go catch it yourself!"
